Point T-140's 'Asked of Adi' at T-384 and remove its wait on T-399. On T-140, the runner now tries the route not yet attempted: run tantra-frontend-v2 locally with seeded data (two 'Adi test' contacts tagged 'attended' and 'not watched', contact time zone send, final newsletter-list step) and capture s3-tantra-pro-flow #5, #13 and #14 with headless Playwright, the way the probe scripts do. If that works, re-crop per T-257, run check-guides and probe-guides, commit, push, update the mirror and set T-140 to review for Amal. If it fails, the three slots stay in T-115's capture manifest and ride on T-384. Do not touch Brave, its profile or its cookies.
